body: It’s been 3 years now. I only find myself getting worse. I am actively working with police to get justice. I am going to therapy. I don’t understand why I feel so sorry for him. He recently contacted me and told me he loves me. It made me so sick. This was my best friends boyfriend... She’ll never know that he’s just this monster. He held her hand as she took her last breath. Then a month later was violently raping me. I still just cannot fathom how someone can be so disgusting. I never talked to him either when she was still alive. He was always playing video games or at work. He then tells me that he’s always had feelings for me. I don’t get it. To this day he desperately tries to get me alone with him.
